name: The Great Cat Spirit
summary: A wise spirit in southern Moonglade teaches druids about the cat’s nature. Its wisdom guides those who seek the feline shape.

sections.title: A Lesson in Moonglade
sections.body: In southern Moonglade, the Great Cat Spirit waits on a hill above the bridge. Druids who seek the feline shape come to it for guidance. You are here to learn what it can teach about the nature of the cat.

faq.q: Where is the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit resides on a hill in southern Moonglade, overlooking the bridge.

faq.q: What does the Great Cat Spirit teach?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit teaches druids about the nature of the cat and the feline shape.

faq.q: Why do druids seek the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: Druids seeking the feline shape come to the Great Cat Spirit for wisdom and guidance.

faq.q: Who is the Great Cat Spirit?
faq.answer: The Great Cat Spirit is a wise, cunning being in southern Moonglade who tutors druids seeking the feline shape.

angles.text: As a druid seeking the feline shape, you come to the Great Cat Spirit in Moonglade for wisdom about the cat.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Cat Spirit
